belize.name: Belize
belize.description: Blue Hole, barrier reef, and atolls teeming with life.
belize.bestTime: From August to December, the sea is calmest. The water is warmest at 29–30°C and cools to about 27°C.

costa-rica.name: Costa Rica
costa-rica.description: Cocos Island, hammerheads, and Pacific coast diving.
costa-rica.bestTime: On the Caribbean coast, March to April brings clear waters and dry days, with warm water at 29–30°C. The Pacific coast offers dry months in January to March and November, with temperatures at a warm 28–30°C.
costa-rica.bestTimeAuto: From December to March, there is the least rain. The water stays a warm 28–30°C all year. Conditions vary by coast.

south-america.name: South America
south-america.description: Paradise with cenotes and whale sharks.
south-america.bestTime: December–May for tropics, November–April for Galápagos.

argentina.name: Argentina
argentina.description: Patagonian kelp forests, sea lions, and cold water diving.
argentina.bestTime: The water warms to 17–18°C in summer and drops to about 10°C in winter.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.description: Fernando de Noronha, wrecks, and warm Atlantic reefs.
brazil.bestTime: In the south, November to March offers the clearest waters, with temperatures ranging from 22°C to 27°C. The north sees its driest months from September to December, maintaining warm waters between 27°C and 29°C.
brazil.bestTimeAuto: From September to December, there is the least rain. The water stays a warm 27–29°C all year. Conditions vary by coast.

rio-grande-do-sul.name: Rio Grande do Sul
rio-grande-do-sul.description: Diving in Rio Grande do Sul.

chile.name: Chile
chile.description: Humboldt current, kelp forests, and Easter Island diving.
chile.bestTime: In Chile, the Pacific coast offers its clearest waters from May to August, with brisk temperatures of 14–18°C. On Easter Island, December brings calm seas and clear water, with a milder 21–26°C.
chile.bestTimeAuto: In December, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water is warmest at 25–26°C and cools to about 21°C. Conditions vary by coast.

ecuador.name: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Galápagos and Pacific coast diving with whale sharks and sea lions.
ecuador.bestTime: In August to September and November, the water is clearest and there is the least rain. The water is warmest at 26–27°C and cools to about 24°C.

galapagos.name: Galápagos Islands
galapagos.description: World-famous for big pelagics, marine iguanas, and unique endemics.
galapagos.bestTime: August to November marks the driest spell in the Galápagos Islands, with waters cooling to 22°C, perfect for exploring its unique marine life.
galapagos.bestTimeAuto: From August to November, there is the least rain. The water is warmest at 26–27°C and cools to about 22°C.

falkland-islands.name: Falkland Islands
falkland-islands.bestTime: In May and July to September, the water is clearest. The water warms to 10–11°C in summer and drops to about 5°C in winter.

panama.name: Panama
panama.description: Caribbean and Pacific coasts, wrecks, reefs, and the Panama Canal.
panama.bestTime: On the Caribbean coast, May and September to October offer calm seas and clear water, while the Pacific coast enjoys similar conditions from January to March with warm waters at 28–30°C.
panama.bestTimeAuto: From December to March, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water stays a warm 28–30°C all year. Conditions vary by coast.

bocas-del-toro-province.name: Bocas del Toro Province
bocas-del-toro-province.description: Diving in Bocas del Toro Province.

peru.name: Peru
peru.description: Cold water diving, kelp forests, sea lions, and Humboldt current marine life along the Pacific coast.
peru.bestTime: From July to November, the water is clearest and there is the least rain. The water is warmest at 23–24°C and cools to about 20°C.

suriname.name: Suriname
suriname.bestTime: In October, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water stays a warm 27–29°C all year.

uruguay.name: Uruguay
uruguay.bestTime: From September to May, the water is clearest. The water warms to 22–23°C in summer and drops to about 12°C in winter.

venezuela.name: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Caribbean coast, coral reefs, and marine parks like Los Roques.
venezuela.bestTime: From July to November, the sea is calmest. The water is warmest at 28–29°C and cools to about 26°C.

rio-grande-do-norte.name: Rio Grande Do Norte
rio-grande-do-norte.description: Diving in Rio Grande Do Norte.
